# Presetter

> Presetter is a small macOS app for Ableton Live 12. It puts every preset from every plugin you own into Live's browser: tagged with each maker's own categories, previewable without loading a plugin, and loaded into the original plugin when you drag one in.

## What it does

- Reads the presets already installed on your Mac for every supported instrument and effect, and the categories each manufacturer gave them.
- Converts each preset into a format Ableton Live loads directly, maps the manufacturer's categories onto Live 12's tags, and renders a short audio preview from your own copy of the plugin.
- Writes one pack folder. You drag it into Places in Live's browser, and from then on you filter, listen and drag in from there. Regenerate the pack when you add a plugin and Live picks up the changes.
- Runs once. It is not a plugin; nothing runs inside Live or in the background. Nothing is uploaded or redistributed. Your plugins and their original presets aren't touched.

## Supported plugins

- Xfer Records: Serum, Serum 2
- Spectrasonics: Omnisphere, Keyscape
- Native Instruments: Kontakt, Massive, Massive X, FM8, Battery 4, Guitar Rig; effects Driver, Replika XT, Raum, Phasis, Flair, Freak, Choral, Bite, Dirt
- Arturia: Pigments, V Collection
- Valhalla DSP: ValhallaVintageVerb, ValhallaSupermassive, ValhallaSpaceModulator
- Every NKS-ready plugin (Native Instruments' preset standard), including u-he Diva, Zebra, Hive, UVI Falcon, Rob Papen, Heavyocity, Output.

## Requirements

- macOS 11 or newer, Intel or Apple silicon
- Ableton Live 12 or newer
- VST3 plugins, installed and licensed on the same Mac
- Windows is planned, not yet available

## Price

- One-time purchase, no subscription. $79 at launch for the beta list, $149 after. Free while it's a beta. All sales final.
